tables.name: users
tables.comment: Registered customer and staff accounts; guests are represented by null user_id on orders/carts

tables.name: roles
tables.comment: RBAC role definitions (e.g. customer, staff, merchandiser, admin)

tables.name: user_roles
tables.comment: Join table assigning roles to users (supports multiple roles per user)

tables.name: addresses
tables.comment: Saved delivery addresses belonging to a registered user

tables.name: serviceable_pin_codes
tables.comment: Lookup table of PIN codes eligible for delivery (REQ-16, REQ-18)

tables.name: categories
tables.comment: Product catalogue categories supporting hierarchical browsing (REQ-46)

tables.name: brands
tables.comment: Brand master used for catalogue filtering (REQ-38)

tables.name: products
tables.comment: Parent product record; variant/CMS attributes stored in JSONB for CMS flexibility (REQ-53, REQ-55)

tables.name: product_images
tables.comment: Images attached to a product (REQ-42)

tables.name: skus
tables.comment: Each size/colour combination is its own SKU with independent stock (BR-3, REQ-37, REQ-43)

tables.name: promo_codes
tables.comment: Promotional codes with percentage or flat discounts and optional expiry (REQ-49, REQ-52, REQ-54)

tables.name: carts
tables.comment: Active shopping carts for registered users and guests (REQ-23, REQ-24, REQ-32)

tables.name: cart_items
tables.comment: Line items within a cart, each referencing a specific SKU (REQ-21, REQ-23)

tables.name: orders
tables.comment: Confirmed and in-progress orders with denormalised current_status and address snapshot (REQ-5, REQ-10, REQ-11, BR-4)
checks: shipping_charge_paise = CASE WHEN (subtotal_paise - discount_paise) >= free_shipping_threshold_paise THEN 0 ELSE shipping_charge_paise END OR current_status = 'pending_payment'
user_id IS NOT NULL OR guest_email IS NOT NULL

tables.name: order_items
tables.comment: Line items for an order with price snapshot at time of purchase (REQ-5)

tables.name: order_status_history
tables.comment: Append-only audit log of every status transition for an order; drives the status timeline UI (REQ-11, REQ-14)

tables.name: stock_reservations
tables.comment: Tracks per-SKU stock held during checkout; released on payment timeout or cancellation (REQ-15, REQ-17, REQ-3)

tables.name: payment_attempts
tables.comment: Each attempt to pay for an order, provider-agnostic; supports retry on failure (REQ-32, REQ-33, REQ-34, BR-4)

tables.name: refunds
tables.comment: Refunds recorded against an originating order and linked to the payment attempt (REQ-13)

tables.name: return_requests
tables.comment: Two-step return flow: customer request followed by staff approval (REQ-6, REQ-7, BR-1)

tables.name: order_tracking
tables.comment: Simulated tracking events for an order (REQ-1)

tables.name: notifications
tables.comment: In-app notification centre; polled by frontend; simulates email/SMS during build (REQ-56)
checks: user_id IS NOT NULL OR guest_email IS NOT NULL

notes: All monetary values are stored as integer paise (1 INR = 100 paise) using bigint to avoid floating-point rounding errors; display layer divides by 100.

The shipping charge business rule (BR-2: free at ₹799+, otherwise ₹49) is enforced at application layer during checkout; the DDL CHECK on orders is a soft guard only since the threshold column makes the rule self-documenting and reconfigurable.
The free_shipping_threshold_paise column on orders (default 79900) captures the threshold value at time of order creation, making the rule auditable even if the threshold changes later.
Prices are stored inclusive of tax as displayed to customers (BR-7); tax_paise columns capture the tax component for GST reporting (BR-5).

Stock reservation expiry (REQ-17, ~15 minutes) is enforced by a background job that queries stock_reservations WHERE status='active' AND expires_at < now(); the expires_at column makes this schedulable without schema changes.
The order current_status CHECK enum matches the order_status_history status CHECK enum exactly; both must be kept in sync when new states are added.
RBAC enforcement (REQ-48, REQ-51) is implemented at application layer using the user_roles join table; the schema provides the data foundation but row-level access rules are enforced in the API.
The products.attributes and skus.variant_attributes JSONB columns support the CMS flexibility requirement (REQ-53) allowing merchandisers to add new variant dimensions without schema migrations.
Guest checkout (REQ-24) is supported via nullable user_id + required guest_email on carts, orders, and notifications; the CHECK constraint ensures at least one is present.

The promo_codes.minimum_order_paise column supports minimum order value rules per promo code, which is a natural extension of the promotions engine (REQ-54) even though no specific minimum is stated beyond the shipping threshold.

The return_window_expires_at on return_requests is computed at request time as order delivered_at + order_item.return_window_days; this denormalisation avoids recalculation and makes the window enforceable by a simple timestamp comparison.
The shipping_charge_paise default of 4900 represents ₹49; the free threshold default of 79900 represents ₹799 — both per BR-2/REQ-28.

Elasticsearch is referenced in the tech stack for autocomplete (REQ-41) and faceted filtering (REQ-38, REQ-40); this PostgreSQL schema is the source of truth that feeds Elasticsearch index sync — no separate ES schema is included here.

The products.average_rating and review_count columns support the rating filter (REQ-38); a reviews table could be added if user-generated reviews become a requirement, but it is not stated in the current requirements.
